title: How to Apply for the SASSA Child Support Grant in 2025
description: A detailed, step-by-step guide to applying for the SASSA Child Support Grant, including eligibility criteria, required documents, and tips to avoid delays.

steps.title: Check Your Eligibility
steps.content: Ensure you and the child meet the requirements: the child must be under 18, a South African citizen or permanent resident, and you must pass the means test.
tips: Single caregiver income must be R5,500/month or less (2025).
Married couples’ combined income must be R11,000/month or less.
Verify eligibility on our eligibility guide.

steps.title: Gather Required Documents
steps.content: Collect all necessary documents before visiting a SASSA office or outreach event to streamline your application.
tips: Include South African ID, child’s birth certificate, and 3-month bank statements.
Ensure documents are recent (not older than 3 months).
Make copies to keep for your records.

steps.title: Submit Application at SASSA
steps.content: Visit a SASSA office or ICROP event, complete the application form with staff assistance, and keep your receipt.
tips: Check SASSA office locations for the nearest branch.
Arrive early to avoid long queues.
Applications are FREE—beware of scams charging fees.

author: SASSA Help Hub Team

title: How to Protect Yourself from SASSA Scams in 2025
description: Learn how to identify and avoid SASSA-related scams, including fake SMS, fraudulent officials, and unauthorized deductions, with actionable steps to stay safe.

steps.title: Identify Common Scam Tactics
steps.content: Recognize scams like fake SMS requesting bank details, impostors posing as SASSA officials, or fraudulent websites mimicking SASSA’s official site.
tips: SASSA never asks for banking details via SMS or email.
Fake websites use URLs like sassa-grants.co.za, not www.sassa.gov.za.
Check our scams page for examples.

steps.title: Verify Official Communications
steps.content: Always confirm SASSA communications through official channels to avoid falling for scams.
tips: Call SASSA at 0800 60 10 11 to verify messages.
Visit www.sassa.gov.za for legitimate updates.

steps.title: Monitor Your Payments
steps.content: Regularly check your grant payments for unauthorized deductions or irregularities, and report issues immediately.
tips: SMS your ID to 34548 to check payment status (R1/SMS).
Report unauthorized deductions via SMS to 34548 with ID and provider details.
Learn more on our payment issues guide.
